vopros: What do you know about Vita Kamliuk, a real estate agent in Los Angeles? Which brokerage is she with?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Vita Kamliuk is currently a real estate agent with Compass in Los Angeles. Her California license is DRE #02166055, and Compass lists her as a REALTOR® specializing in buyer representation, listings, relocation, and property management. She works in English and Russian. ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

Her professional background is somewhat unusual for an LA residential agent. According to her current bio, she has roughly 18 years of real-estate experience, including earlier commercial-real-estate work with Knight Frank and Colliers International. Her current focus is Greater Los Angeles residential real estate, particularly the San Fernando Valley (Sherman Oaks, Valley Village, Studio City, Tarzana, etc.) and Westside/Beverly Hills/West Hollywood markets. ([askvita.com](https://askvita.com/?utm_source=openai))

She was previously with Keller Williams Beverly Hills. A 2022 VoyageLA profile identifies her as working from the Keller Williams Beverly Hills office, so older references to Keller Williams are not necessarily incorrect; she subsequently moved to Compass. ([voyagela.com](https://voyagela.com/interview/exploring-life-business-with-vita-kamliuk-of-keller-williams/?utm_source=openai))

As of September 2026, multiple current sources confirm the Compass affiliation, including her official Compass agent page and recent professional posts identifying her as “Vita Kamliuk | DRE #02166055 | Compass.” ([compass.com](https://www.compass.com/agents/vita-kamliuk/?utm_source=openai))

If you're considering hiring her, I can also look into her recent sales/listings, transaction history, reviews, and any publicly available licensing/disciplinary information to give you a more independent picture than an agent bio.
